sources: October partnering brochure; chart labeled July 2026
2025 universal registration document, April 2026: ImCheck, Marengo and Foreseen provenance
gaps: Company-wide phase totals and dated next milestones beyond navtemadlin’s 2027 readout were not verified.
IPN60340 is represented as Phase 2 from the partnering chart; EVICTION 3 is described as Phase II/III. A standalone active Phase III component was not established.
Potravitug is represented as Phase 2; Q3 results describe Phase II/III development without establishing a completed transition to the Phase III component.
IPN01203 and IPN60300 are represented as Phase 1 within their Phase I/II studies. Corabotase’s Phase 3 entry refers to glabellar lines; other indications are in Phase 2.
The April 2026 annual filing and AACR release used for provenance and mechanism predate June 2026; current-stage evidence uses the July/October pipeline materials.
Exact filing acceptance dates and jurisdictions for Dysport migraine submissions were not verified. The selected assets are not an exhaustive list of major new-indication programmes.
